title: Validate successful LTE attach and detach procedure with single UE under excellent radio conditions
description: Perform 10 iterations of LTE Attach and Detach procedure with a single UE in excellent radio conditions, validating 100% success rate and measuring attach latency.
preconditions: Single LTE cell active and unloaded; no other cells powered on
Single UE (real or emulated) placed at cell center with excellent LTE RSRP level
Test configuration parameters recorded
End-to-end LTE setup operational with no connectivity issues
testSteps: Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait for attach complete confirmation (attach request and attach complete messages validated in logs)
Measure and record attach latency from attach request to attach complete
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated LTE detach procedure
Wait for detach accept confirmation (detach request and detach accept messages validated in logs)
Stop and save logs
Repeat steps 2 to 7 for a total of 10 iterations
Verify UE attached to correct LTE cell by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, and ARFCN in UE logs
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations
Attach latency recorded with minimum, average, and maximum values
Signaling messages conform to 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.8.2.1
UE is attached to the correct LTE cell as per test configuration
postconditions: UE detached and cell remains active for further tests
commandsUsed: Generic action: Verify signaling messages in logs
verificationMethods: Log analysis for attach/detach signaling messages
Verification of radio parameters in UE logs

title: Validate successful 5G NSA attach and detach procedure with single UE under excellent radio conditions
description: Perform 10 iterations of 5G NSA Attach and Detach procedure with a single UE in excellent radio conditions, validating 100% success rate including secondary node addition and release.
preconditions: Single LTE + 5G NSA cell active and unloaded; no other cells powered on
Single UE (real or emulated) placed at cell center with excellent 5G SS-RSRP level
Test configuration parameters recorded
End-to-end 5G NSA setup operational with no connectivity issues
testSteps: Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure
Wait for attach complete confirmation including EN-DC Secondary Node Addition (SgNB addition request and reconfiguration complete messages validated)
Measure and record attach latency from attach request to attach complete
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated detach procedure including Secondary Node Release
Wait for detach accept confirmation (detach request and detach accept messages validated), and SgNB release confirmation
Stop and save logs
Repeat steps 2 to 7 for a total of 10 iterations
Verify UE attached to correct LTE and 5G cells by checking PCI, Global eNB ID/Global gNB ID, ARFCN and NR-ARFCN in UE logs
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations including secondary node addition
Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations including secondary node release
Attach latency recorded with minimum, average, and maximum values
Signaling messages conform to 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1, 5.3.8.2.1 and 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1 and 10.4.1
UE is attached to the correct LTE and 5G NSA cells as per test configuration
postconditions: UE detached and cell remains active for further tests
commandsUsed: Generic action: Verify signaling messages in logs including SgNB addition and release
verificationMethods: Log analysis for attach/detach and secondary node addition/release signaling messages
Verification of radio parameters in UE logs

title: Validate LTE attach failure when UE is forced to attach to incorrect cell parameters
description: Attempt LTE attach procedure where UE is configured with incorrect PCI, Global eNB ID, or ARFCN values, expecting attach failure and appropriate error handling.
preconditions: Single LTE cell active
UE configured/emulated with invalid or mismatched cell identity parameters
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON UE to initiate LTE attach
Observe attach procedure failure due to cell parameter mismatch
Verify UE does not attach to cell
Power OFF UE
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails gracefully with appropriate failure messages in logs
Attach success rate is 0%
No UE context established in network
UE remains detached
postconditions: UE detached and cell remains active
commandsUsed: Generic action: Power ON UE with invalid config
Generic action: Verify failure signaling messages
verificationMethods: Log analysis for attach failure cause
Validation of absence of UE context in network

title: Validate 5G NSA detach failure when Secondary Node rejects release request
description: Simulate scenario where SN rejects SgNB Release Request during UE detach, verifying correct handling and error recovery.
preconditions: 5G NSA cell active with UE attached
Test setup able to simulate SN rejection of SgNB Release Request message
testSteps: Start logging to capture call flow
Power OFF UE to initiate detach including SN release
Observe SN sending SgNB Release Request Acknowledge message rejecting SN release
Verify MN and UE handle rejection correctly and maintain connection or retry procedures
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: SN rejection of release is correctly handled without UE context loss
No unexpected UE disconnect occurs
Error recovery or retry procedures initiated as per specification
Detach success rate less than 100%, failure properly logged
postconditions: UE remains attached or properly detached after recovery
commandsUsed: Generic action: Simulate SN rejection message
Generic action: Verify signaling and error handling
verificationMethods: Log analysis for rejection and recovery flow

title: Measure attach latency at boundary conditions of radio signal strength
description: Perform LTE and 5G NSA attach tests with UE placed at the minimum acceptable excellent radio condition limit to observe attach latency behavior at boundary RSRP/SS-RSRP values.
preconditions: Single LTE or 5G NSA cell active
Variable attenuator/fading generator configured to set UE radio conditions exactly at the minimum coupling loss threshold defined in Clause 4.6
UE placed accordingly
testSteps: Start logging
Power ON UE to initiate attach
Measure attach latency and success rate
Power OFF UE to detach
Repeat for 10 iterations
Record latency min, avg, max
expectedResults: Attach success rate remains 100% at minimum excellent radio condition boundary
Attach latency may show increased values but remains within acceptable limits
No attach failures due to radio conditions
postconditions: UE detached and cell remains active

title: Stress test by performing rapid UE power ON/OFF cycles during attach/detach
description: Perform 10 rapid attach/detach cycles with minimal delay between UE Power ON and Power OFF to test system robustness to fast UE state changes.
preconditions: Single LTE or 5G NSA cell active
UE placed under excellent radio conditions
testSteps: Start logging
Power ON UE to initiate attach
Immediately after attach success, power OFF UE to detach
Repeat for 10 rapid cycles
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates remain high (>95%) despite rapid cycling
No system crashes or connection losses
Signaling flows complete successfully or handled gracefully if interrupted
commandsUsed: Generic action: Power ON/OFF UE rapidly
verificationMethods: Log analysis for signaling correctness and error handling

Start logging
Perform 100 attach/detach cycles sequentially
Record attach and detach success rates and latencies
Stop logging and monitoring
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates remain near 100% throughout
Attach latencies remain stable with no significant degradation
System resource usage remains within acceptable limits without crashes or slowdowns
postconditions: Test logs and performance monitoring data saved

title: Validate authentication and authorization during attach and detach procedures
description: Verify that attach procedure enforces authentication and authorization per 3GPP TS 23.401, and unauthorized UEs are rejected.
preconditions: Network configured with authentication and authorization mechanisms
One valid UE and one unauthorized UE available
testSteps: Start logging
Power ON valid UE and verify successful attach
Power OFF valid UE to detach
Power ON unauthorized UE and observe attach rejection
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Valid UE is authenticated and authorized successfully and attaches with 100% success
Unauthorized UE attach attempts are rejected with appropriate cause codes
Detach procedures function normally for valid UE
verificationMethods: Log analysis for authentication success/failure messages

Switch UE attachment from LTE cell to 5G NSA cell and back, performing attach/detach each time
Stop and save logs
Record KPIs for each scenario
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates 100% in all scenarios
Attach latencies conform to KPI targets
Correct signaling flows for LTE and 5G NSA scenarios
No connectivity loss or errors during interworking
commandsUsed: Generic action: Switch UE between LTE and 5G NSA cells
verificationMethods: Log analysis for attach/detach flows in both RATs

Observe network handling of incomplete detach procedure
Stop and save logs

No persistent UE context remains
Logs capture failure and recovery actions
commandsUsed: Generic action: Apply radio signal attenuation
verificationMethods: Log analysis for detach failure and recovery
